_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The coil regime (5% of 12h windows moving ±2+ points) makes HOLD the statistically honest call; a directional break toward Disbelief requires confirmed fear_greed recovery above 30 and sustained BTC momentum above 70.
next_move.brains_agree: Split — analyst recommends HOLD with medium conviction citing coil evidence; narrative implies directional LONG bias via accumulation framing without explicitly calling direction
next_move.confirmed_if: fear_greed breaks above 30 with btc_momentum_30d sustaining above 70 and DXY breaking below 99.5
next_move.invalidated_if: fear_greed drops below 20 with VIX spiking above 22 and funding flipping negative — signals Denial rolling back toward Anxiety/Panic
